correctness.rationale: Radial beta moments m_j=Γ(j+1)Γ(α+2)/Γ(j+α+2) and the orthonormal harmonic monomial basis make T a bilateral positive weighted n-shift. Angular projection yields all three k>=0, k<=−n and bridge squared-weight branches; the moment ratios strictly increase, so each residue class has squared weights decreasing from 1 to minimum v_r=m_n²/(m_r m_{n−r}) then increasing back to 1. Telescoping total variation therefore proves ||[T*,T]||_1=2∑(1−v_r) and zero trace. Digamma monotonicity proves strict α trend; direct m_j=1/(j+1) yields n(5n+1)/(3(n+1)). Both weight tails have 1−w_k=n(α+1)/(2|k|)+O(k^-2), so sorting both tails yields N s_N→n(α+1), S_p iff p>1 and the logarithmic sum. Independently rederived 44 exact rational residue valleys and 12 pairs of long-index tail coefficients and verified unweighted rational cases. Finite checks are not substitutes for infinite asymptotics.

final_claim: For α>−1 and n>=1, harmonic weighted Bergman monomial Toeplitz compression T_{α,n} has trace-class self-commutator of trace zero and trace norm 2∑_{r=0}^{n−1}(1−m_n²/(m_r m_{n−r})), strictly increasing in α from 0 to 2n. Its polar defect I−|T| lies in S_p exactly for p>1 and has N s_N→n(α+1) and logarithmic singular-sum coefficient n(α+1).
limitations: Monomial z^n only, not arbitrary analytic polynomial symbols
